unresolved: Field Notes did not play-test any of these games, or the two PMD fan hacks, on any emulator or device for this issue. Controller mappings, performance and save behaviour are not verified.

Azure Dreams lead screenshot comes from late in a reader gallery and may show an ending or credits sequence rather than ordinary play. It is in-engine and on a tower floor, and the caption avoids claiming the context.

Contemporary review scores for EGM, Game Informer, GameFan, OPM, Next Generation and Famitsu (Azure Dreams) and Famitsu (Baroque, PMD) come from Wikipedia's reception tables; the original magazine pages were not read.
RPGamer's Z.H.P. and PMD numeric scores were not captured.
Z.H.P. claims about the Unlosing Cape and Plug-S come from a GameFAQs board thread and are labelled as community advice.
The PMD defeat penalty differs between the Sky manual (half your money, some items) and Wikipedia's Explorers summary (all money, half or more of your items). The article follows the manual.
Baroque PS1 differences claimed in the romhacking.net forum (floor count, Collector) are labelled as unverified fan claims.
The Wii version of the Baroque remake is mentioned but not covered; its controls were not researched.
